note: Paths leg only, declared with the plan 4.17 wave-2 consolidation (2026-11-13): the venue suite (pytest, tests/) keeps its own runner and interpreter story, as before this package carried no gate.json at all; enrolling the suite in the composed gate is a separate disposition. The spine is paths.py at the package root; bin/_load.py binds the tree's roots from it. The suite key declares the suite's parallel form only, and {workers} in its argv resolves through gate.runner.derive_workers. The portability enrollment (2026-11-14, gate-hygiene pass) adds the denylist-carrying component leg in the registry form, fail_on_denylist auto; its generic-leg findings on tool-layout and specimen strings are exempted per exact string by directives in the carrying files (gate.portability EXCEPTION_FILES), and its plan-file citations were cured to title form. The date-uniqueness leg (2026-11-16, dup-2026-11-16): one shared date helper per intent per cluster — gate.dateuniqueness over the family map in gate/date_families.json. The writer-uniqueness adoption (2026-11-17, binding-writer enforcement): gate.writeruniqueness over this package — every durable state write rides pipeline/platform/writer.py; the funnel and lease-foundation seams stand in the component's own table; the liveness state file, the transfer records and the panel's reaper-drain offset were adopted onto the writer with this declaration, and the exec-staging payloads (transient scripts staged under var/ to feed session execs) plus the hash-verified chunk parts are declared per file with their kinds.
